decision.explanation: Document D1S2 explicitly states that 'Let George Do It (US: "To Hell With Hitler") is a 1940 British black-and-white comedy musical war film directed by Marcel Varnel and starring George Formby.' This directly identifies George Formby as the main actor in the 1940 film *Let George Do It*. Other candidates like George Wallace and Bob Bailey refer to different versions of the title (a 1938 film and a 1946–1954 radio series respectively), which are distinct works and not relevant to the 1940 film. Charlie Chaplin is mentioned in a review but is not stated to be part of the film itself.
